decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - C13	The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises for dry ice production, storage and distribution and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used for dry ice production, storage and distribution and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class  B2  of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 6 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No additional fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted commences, the applicant shall investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required.  Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA.   Or the applicant shall install gas protection measures as a precautionary measure without first investigating the site.  The details of these measures shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA.  All required measures shall be installed before the development is first occupied.

Condition : 10 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No.SI-HOU-0006, REV P4 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
description: Change of use of Unit 10 from B8 (Storage & Distribution) to B2 (General Industrial) use to accomodate dry ice production plant, change of use of Unit 11 from B8 (Storage & Distribution) to B2 (General Industrial) to food grade dry ice packaging area, re-location of warehousing facility from Unit 11 to 12. Construction of cooling tower, 2 x liquid Carbon Dioxide storage tanks and one transformer sub- station. Installation of external extraction louvres, erection of security fencing around front yard and reconfigured parking layout to existing site.
